work_item: Restore wider map, GPS, and world-scale affordances
human_facing_rationale: The Act 1 GPS/world-map affordance now exposes a wider Arizona route map with current location, known places, locked city-scale destinations, and a quest badge in the live runtime. The after screenshot is modestly clearer for a child because the current position and quest destination are labeled directly on the map instead of relying only on small rings and legend inference. The collapsed HUD remains compact and the larger GPS art appears only when the map is open, reducing playfield clutter.
